title: Simultaneous semilinear open tensor model data
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ and pinned ordinary open operations $o$ [def-sf-integral-open-operations]. Use the completed coefficient modules, finite coefficients $A_{n+1}$, strict quotient-system categories [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], and fixed normalized reduction calculi $S_X,S_U$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Use the integral and finite extension generators, finite tensor comparison datum $\tau$, augmented-presentation predicate, and strict-system open extension of [def-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison-data]. All complexes are unbounded. Define $e_!$ and $e^*$ on complexes termwise. Define the ordinary tensor, direct-sum total tensor with signed differential, summand insertions and flat-term predicate by the existing semilinear-system models [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. A restricted section is identified with its ambient slice section by the actual slice-equivalence counit and prescribed coefficient transport.

A total comparison datum consists of ordinary isomorphisms $\mu_{M,N}:e_!M\otimes N\cong e_!(M\otimes e^*N)$, natural in both module maps, and chain isomorphisms $\phi_{Q,F}:\operatorname{Tot}(e_!Q\otimes F)\cong e_!\operatorname{Tot}(Q\otimes e^*F)$, natural in both chain maps. On each extension generator require $[x]\otimes y\mapsto[x\otimes e^*y]$ under the actual slice-section identification. On every homogeneous summand $a+b=d$, require its inclusion followed by $\phi^d$ to equal $\mu_{Q^a,F^b}$ followed by the extended inclusion of the $(a,b)$ summand, with no additional sign.

An ordinary reduction datum on $W$ is one additive functor $A_W:\operatorname{Mod}(B_W)\to\mathscr S_W$, with natural isomorphisms $\operatorname{ev}_n A_W\cong(-\otimes_{B_W}A_{n+1})$ commuting with EVERY quotient transition $n\le m$. Its evaluation on complexes is the termwise natural isomorphism. For each K-flat complex $Q$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], a computation datum consists of an isomorphism from $S_W\operatorname{red}(Q)$ to the localization of the termwise $A_W(Q)$, with both the fixed calculus reduction-presentation condition and the specified augmented-presentation condition for the termwise evaluation maps.

Define K-flat preservation to mean that $e_!$ sends every flat-term K-flat complex on $U$ to a K-flat complex on $X$ [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For a natural ordinary strict-system isomorphism $a:e_!A_X\cong A_UJ$, its chain comparison is the termwise isomorphism with degree-$i$ map $a_{Q^i}$. Given a derived comparison $r:j_!\operatorname{red}_X\cong\operatorname{red}_U J$, define its representative square to require, for EVERY flat-term K-flat $Q$, computation data $c_U,c_X$ on $Q,e_!Q$ such that $r_Q$ followed by $J(c_U)$ and the system-extension localization factor equals the integral-extension localization factor followed by $c_X$ and localization of the termwise ordinary comparison. This is an equation of whole derived strict-system arrows before finite evaluation.

Define a simultaneous semilinear open tensor comparison datum to consist of a total comparison datum, preservation of flat terms on flat-term K-flat complexes, K-flat preservation, a natural ordinary strict-system isomorphism $a$ as above, and $r$ on the entire derived category. Require at every finite coefficient and every module $M$ that evaluation of $a_M$, followed by extension evaluation and finite extension of the ordinary reduction evaluation, equals ordinary reduction evaluation of $e_!M$ followed by $\tau_n(M)$. Finally require the representative square for $r,a$ and the specified preservation witness. No completeness, boundedness, quasi-compactness or finite-Tor hypothesis is part of this definition, and no existence of such data is asserted.
